newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana Stock Exchange closes lower in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Ghana Stock Exchange closes lower in thin trade.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange closed lower on Wednesday in thin trade with offers outstripping demand, its daily trading report showed.
The GSE All-Share Index fell 2.77 points to 381.54 from Monday's 384.31 points.
Ashanti Goldfields, the market's dominant share, shed 500 cedis to close at 29,000 cedis. Market sources blamed price movements on the London Stock Exchange.
Mobil Oil Ghana Limited was the other main faller, shedding 500 cedis to 6,500 cedis.
Offers exceeded demand by 1,653,500 to 149,250. A total of 15,370 shares were traded compared to 434,900 shares on Monday.
Market capitalisation slipped to 3,206.96 billion cedis from 3,256.84 billion cedis on Monday.
